title: British-Style Fish Wrap
description: A classic British-inspired fish wrap recipe featuring a delicate fish fillet in a tangy anchovy sauce, wrapped in a crispy British-style wrap.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
2. Season the fish fillet with salt, pepper, and nutty seasoning.
3. Add a small amount of butter or oil to the skillet and cook the fish for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, mix together the anchovy paste, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
5. Spread the anchovy sauce on the British-style wrap.
6. Once the fish is cooked, place it on the wrap, and top with a squeeze of lemon.
7. Fold the wrap to enclose the filling, and serve immediately.
